Class SimpleBoard

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.model.SimpleBoard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Board
public class SimpleBoard extends Object implements Board
Implementation of the Board interface representing the game board state. Manages the game matrix, brick placement, line clearing, power-ups, and special mechanics such as bedrock corruption and drill movement. The board uses a matrix representation where: - Rows (Y-axis) range from 0 to width-1 (typically 0-24) - Columns (X-axis) range from 0 to height-1 (typically 0-9) - Matrix access is [row][column] = [y][x]

    • spawnDrill

      public void spawnDrill()
      COMPLETE REDESIGN: Spawns a drill projectile, completely replacing the current brick. This is a clean state transition - the previous brick is completely discarded. The drill spawns at the top of the board at the player's current X position.

    • corruptNextRow

      public boolean corruptNextRow()
      Corrupts the next row by converting existing blocks to bedrock. Bedrock is indestructible and cannot be cleared. This method is called periodically in Power-Ups mode to create the "rising tide" effect. Starts from the bottom (row 24) and works upwards.
      Returns:
      true if corruption was successful, false if game over (corruption row < 0)

    • hasFloatingBlocks

      public boolean hasFloatingBlocks()
      Checks if there are any floating blocks (blocks with empty space below them). Used to determine when gravity animation should stop after power-up usage.
      Returns:
      true if any block has empty space (0) immediately beneath it and is not on the floor

    • applyGravityStep

      public void applyGravityStep()
      Applies one step of gravity, moving floating blocks down by one row. This is called repeatedly to create a cascading "avalanche" effect after power-up usage (bomb or drill). Respects bedrock as solid barriers.
